Problem Statement:
The problem statement is simple: you are given an array of integers having N integers. All integers are positive and greater than 0. You are given Q queries. In each query you must report the gcd of the numbers in the given range L to R. In other words assume the array is A[1] A[2] A[3].....A[N] (1-based indexing). gcd[L,R]= gcd(A[L],A[L+1].....A[R])
input_spec:
The first line contain a single integer N denoting the number of integers
The second line contains N integers: the contents if the array A.
The third line contains a single integer Q denoting the number of queries
The next Q line has two integers each L R : denoting the gcd of the range[L,R]
output_spec: Your output must consist of Q lines each line containing the range gcd for a query
